stem: Lumen Health wants chargeback-grade database spend data for custom SQL analysis and proactive warnings before crossing monthly limits. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Rely on Amazon EventBridge health events as the main cost analytics dataset.
Publish AWS Cost and Usage Report data for detailed line-item analysis.
Use AWS Secrets Manager rotation reports as the monthly spend forecasting source.
Track RDS failover events only to represent database cost behavior.
Create AWS Budgets alerts on actual and forecasted spend thresholds.

rationale: CUR provides the most detailed billing dataset for SQL-based chargeback analysis. AWS Budgets provides threshold-based alerts on actual or forecasted spending. EventBridge health events are operational notifications, not cost line items. Secrets Manager reports do not model full database spending. Failover events reflect availability transitions, not cost forecasting.
